integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, warm tungsten light, an extreme close framing on a fingertip (the same camera setup later mirrored on Lin Wan's finger). Off the close-up, Lin Wan (S2) asks: <d>[Chinese]扎了？</d> Chen Yu (S1) briefly puts the finger to his mouth, pulls out a tissue and presses it, saying flatly: <d>[Chinese]没有。</d> Lin Wan (S2) says: <d>[Chinese]那你快点。</d> reaching the tissue-pressed finger pose of Picture 2. No exaggerated gore.

overall_soundscape: Warm dinner ambience continues softly, with the small sounds of a shell tip pricking skin, a quick inhale, and a tissue being pulled free.

non_diegetic_music: A single low piano note held quietly under the moment.
